experience.description: Tutored 15 first-year students in weekly programming workshops.
Built a microservice for internal billing using Java Spring Boot.
Maintained a Next.js marketing site and built React components.
Managed a £4,000 annual budget and organised six student events.
Supported 30 students through weekly Verilog lab exercises.
Co-authored a paper on low-power FPGA inference accepted at ICCAD 2026.
Built ETL pipelines processing 10M+ rows per day in Python and SQL.

jobs.title: Teaching Assistant - DNA to Organisms
jobs.description: Support BIO 93 discussions and introductory biology activities covering genetics, cells, and the flow of biological information.
requirements: Coursework in introductory biology or equivalent
Ability to explain genetics and cell biology clearly

jobs.title: Teaching Assistant - Biochemistry
jobs.description: Support BIO 98 tutorials on biomolecules, enzymes, metabolism, and interpretation of biochemical experiments.
responsibilities: Grade problem sets and lab reports

jobs.title: Teaching Assistant - Human Physiology
jobs.description: Support BIO E109 students in understanding human physiology through discussion, guided exercises, and laboratory preparation.
requirements: Coursework in human physiology or equivalent
Clear communication and safe laboratory practice

jobs.title: Teaching Assistant - Bioinformatics
jobs.description: Support the BIO INF1 demo course with practical analysis of biological data using Python, R, and Linux.
requirements: Working knowledge of Python or R and Linux

jobs.title: Teaching Assistant - Molecular Biology
jobs.description: Support BIO 99 tutorials on nucleic acids, gene expression, and molecular biology methods.
requirements: Coursework in molecular biology or equivalent
Ability to explain gene expression and experimental methods

jobs.title: Lab Assistant - DNA to Organisms (Summer)
jobs.description: Summer-term BIO 93 discussion support. This closed demonstration posting is retained for historical workflow examples.
requirements: Coursework in introductory biology or equivalent

messages.content: Hello Dr. Turing, I just submitted my application for the BIO 93 TA position. Could you let me know roughly when shortlisting decisions will be made? Thanks, Alex.
Hi Alex, thanks for your application. We aim to complete shortlisting within two weeks. You will receive a notification on the platform as soon as your status changes. Best, Alan.
Hi Carol, congratulations on the offer for BIO 93 TA. Please reply to this message with your acceptance before Friday and we will get the paperwork started. Best, Alan.
Dear Dr. Turing, thank you so much. I am delighted to accept the offer. I will be in touch with HR this week. Kind regards, Carol.
Hi Diana, your BIO 99 TA interview is confirmed for 8 December at 09:30 in EE Building Room 2.10. Please come 5 minutes early. Best, Linus.
Hi admin team, the platform has been really easy to use so far. Small suggestion: could the dashboard surface upcoming interview dates more prominently? Thanks, Alex.
